title: REISER showcases expanded Berg-Moerlbach site
summary: The event showcased the capabilities behind REISER’s growing portfolio of advanced training systems.
body_markdown:
On Sept. 15, Reiser Simulation and Training GmbH (REISER) welcomed representatives of the international training and simulation community to its “Summer Networking” event, offering guests an inside look at the company’s significantly expanded facilities.


The event showcased the capabilities behind REISER’s growing portfolio of advanced training systems and underlined the rising demand for realistic, scalable and mission-relevant training solutions.


Throughout the day, product presentations, live demonstrations and expert briefings provided a practical view of how training systems are designed, manufactured and prepared for operational use.


Highlights on display included the[H145](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h145) D3 XR-Simulator, the new 11-foot helicopter full-flight simulator and the full-scale NH90 Sea Tiger Maintenance Training Rig.


Together, the systems illustrated REISER’s ability to support both crew and maintenance training with solutions customized to the demanding requirements of civil and military operations.


The Summer Networking event also provided a forum for direct exchange between customers, industry partners and REISER’s engineering and program teams. Discussions centered on current training needs, future capability requirements and the role of simulation in improving readiness, safety and efficiency across operational domains.


“The additional capacity at Berg-Mörlbach responds to specific customer programs and long-term training requirements, while underscoring our commitment to Bavaria and Germany as a strategic base,” said Dr. Johannes Hain, CEO of REISER. “Summer Networking provided an opportunity to show how these investments translate into operational training capabilities.”


*This press release was prepared and distributed by REISER Simulation and Training.*
